scope: reusable environment-illumination and atmosphere audit across unrelated architectural hosts
acceptedSystemEvidence: live online acquisition passes bounded HTTPS redirect, provider licence, exact resolution, archive-entry, OpenEXR structure, colour-space and deterministic identity checks
the lighting schema v2 package binds and restages the complete source manifest, API response, provider licence page, Videoer assessment, archive, OpenEXR inspection and radiance bytes
negated Blender Geometry Incoming direction maps source sky above source ground and Z-axis yaw moves recognizable panorama regions
the neutral Cycles transfer passes unchanged visibility, highlight, tonal-balance and spatial-colour-variation gates after a declared two-stop adaptation
rig-owned lights remain exact while unrelated shot-local practical lights compose without being mistaken for rig drift
both architectural hosts consume the identical radiance SHA-256 through Cycles while retaining their existing local and interior lights

finite smoothly tapered mesh volumes replace infinite World fog, leave World Volume unlinked, preserve HDRI illumination and contain every evaluated visible mesh, camera and target over every rendered frame
both host renders pass their structural, camera, texture, water-field, optical-surface, lighting and finite-fog verification gates
blockingVisualDefects: neither host is photorealistic enough for publication despite the corrected reflection-bearing lighting context
historic paving has exaggerated relief, deep black gaps and excessively noisy/repeated stone response; wet optical regions can read as missing units or dark holes
contemporary pavers remain oversized and slab-like, with broad dark joints, abrupt missing-looking regions and insufficient unit-to-unit construction variation
facade shells remain clean blockout forms with mechanically sharp profiles, sparse weathering and weak material-layer depth
windows and interiors remain sparse witness spaces with flat or empty-looking glazing, limited furnishing density and insufficient lived-in variation
rain remains a collection of detached bright streaks without convincing splash, mist, runoff and depth-dependent atmospheric integration
the finite fog contract is structurally correct but the current density and host staging do not yet produce rich cinematic depth separation
the shared HDRI improves reflections and exposes materials honestly, but it also makes scale, roughness, bevel, repetition and environment-integration errors more visible
nextGenericDependencies: physically plausible paving dimensions and joint depths per construction class
multi-scale per-unit colour, roughness, dirt, wear and edge-breakup variation without photographed-layout duplication
calibrated optical-water reconstruction and material response that cannot resemble holes or missing paving
layered facade construction materials with believable bevel scale, weathering, runoff, staining and repair history
denser reusable interior-room kits, glazing variation, practical fixtures and occupancy evidence
receiver-aware splash, runoff, mist and depth-layered rain integration
shot-distance-specific atmospheric calibration using the accepted finite-volume contract
additional legally cleared HDRI/environment families selected by host, weather and time-of-day semantics rather than one universal source
notes: This is an audit of reusable production systems, not benchmark-specific polishing. Correct HDRI directionality and finite fog materially improved the evidence and isolated the next deficiencies in shared geometry, materials, water, interiors and atmospheric integration. Automated pass status does not override the visual rejection, and no lighting, environment or host asset is published by this review. Production clothing remains queued behind this environment/material tranche exactly as recorded in the progress document.
